query: 'SELECT CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), f.fecha, 112) AS INT) AS fecha_key,
       f.fecha AS fecha_completa,
       CAST(YEAR(f.fecha) AS SMALLINT) AS anio,
       CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS trimestre,
       CONCAT('T', DATEPART(QUARTER, f.fecha)) AS trimestre_nombre,
       CAST(MONTH(f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS mes,
       UPPER(LEFT(FORMAT(f.fecha, 'MMMM', 'es-ES'), 1)) + SUBSTRING(FORMAT(f.fecha, 'MMMM', 'es-ES'), 2, 20) AS mes_nombre,
       UPPER(LEFT(FORMAT(f.fecha, 'MMMM', 'es-ES'), 1)) + SUBSTRING(FORMAT(f.fecha, 'MMMM', 'es-ES'), 2, 2) AS mes_corto,
       CAST(DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS semana_anio,
       CAST(DAY(f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS dia_mes,
       CAST((DATEPART(WEEKDAY, f.fecha) + @@DATEFIRST - 2) % 7 + 1 AS TINYINT) AS dia_semana,
       UPPER(LEFT(FORMAT(f.fecha, 'dddd', 'es-ES'), 1)) + SUBSTRING(FORMAT(f.fecha, 'dddd', 'es-ES'), 2, 20) AS dia_nombre,
       CAST(CASE WHEN FORMAT(f.fecha, 'dddd', 'en-US') IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS es_fin_de_semana
FROM (
    SELECT admission_date AS fecha FROM silver.admissions
    UNION
    SELECT discharge_date FROM silver.admissions WHERE discharge_date IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT payment_date FROM silver.billing WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL
) f',
